_about: Photos used on the site pages. 'source' is the original (kept out of git: docs/Photos for the church's own photos, docs/photos-source/old-site for images downloaded from the old website). scripts/build-photos.sh turns each into <slug>.webp here. 'alt' is the starting alt text (staff can change it in the editor). 'rights' records where the picture came from and what we know about the licence.
